courses.title: 封裝寄生參數萃取
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入回流路徑、頻率相依 RLGC 與模型因果性；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine return paths, frequency-dependent rlgc and model causality. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。準靜態 RLGC 模型不能跨越明顯輻射或共振區間；需以電氣長度、全波結果與量測共同界定適用頻帶。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Quasi-static RLGC does not automatically cover radiative or resonant regimes; bound its band using electrical length, full-wave results and measurement.

stages.title: 回流與埠定義
stages.description: 本階段處理回流與埠定義：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address returns and ports through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 畫出閉合電流回路
steps.objective: 建立「畫出閉合電流回路」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：自感、互感與回流一起決定回路電感，參考導體不是可省略的裝飾。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for draw closed current loops: Self and mutual inductance combine with the return path; reference conductors cannot be omitted.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。保持信號幾何固定，只移動回流平面，比較回路電感。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Keep signal geometry fixed and move only the return plane; compare loop inductance. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：保持信號幾何固定，只移動回流平面，比較回路電感。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Keep signal geometry fixed and move only the return plane; compare loop inductance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：只有信號線就能定義唯一回路電感。本步先檢查「畫出閉合電流回路」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到自感、互感與回流一起決定回路電感，參考導體不是可省略的裝飾。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A signal trace alone defines a unique loop inductance. First check whether evidence for draw closed current loops actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Self and mutual inductance combine with the return path; reference conductors cannot be omitted.
steps.check: 交付「畫出閉合電流回路」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

steps.titleEn: Build capacitance and admittance matrices: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「建立電容與導納矩陣」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the build capacitance and admittance matrices model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較浮接屏蔽與接地屏蔽，檢查矩陣符號與總電荷。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare floating and grounded shields; check matrix signs and total charge. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較浮接屏蔽與接地屏蔽，檢查矩陣符號與總電荷。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare floating and grounded shields; check matrix signs and total charge. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：網格越細就不必檢查埠定義。本步先檢查「建立電容與導納矩陣」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到導體間電容與對地電容共同決定電荷守恆，浮接金屬會改變電場邊界。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A fine mesh removes the need to check ports. First check whether evidence for build capacitance and admittance matrices actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mutual and ground capacitances jointly determine charge conservation; floating metal changes field boundaries.
steps.check: 交付「建立電容與導納矩陣」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for build capacitance and admittance matrices: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.title: 做網格收斂試驗

steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Refine critical gaps and track impedance and stored energy rather than color maps alone. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

courses.title: 封裝內去耦電容整合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入去耦電容、ESR/ESL 與反共振；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine decoupling capacitance, esr/esl and antiresonance. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。ΔV=IΔt/C 是初始電荷估算；有效電容、路徑電感與穩壓器響應決定真實瞬態，不能以標稱容量直接保證電源品質。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. ΔV=IΔt/C is an initial charge estimate; effective capacitance, loop inductance and regulator response govern actual transients.

stages.descriptionEn: Address charge and impedance needs through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：並聯越多種容量必定降低所有頻率阻抗。本步先檢查「界定負載電荷」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到電流脈衝面積才是電荷需求，峰值相同的兩個脈衝可能需要不同儲能。所指出的物理限制。

steps.instruction:

courses.title: 共封裝電源轉換器
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入共封裝電源的開關損耗、磁性元件與熱路；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine switching loss, magnetics and thermal paths in co-packaged power. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。理想 buck 公式用於教學起點；磁芯非線性、寄生、控制模式與散熱邊界都會改變實際波形。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Ideal buck equations are teaching starting points; magnetic nonlinearity, parasitics, control mode and thermal boundaries alter real waveforms.

stages.title: 功率需求與拓撲

stages.descriptionEn: Address power needs and topology through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

knowledge.text: 在半橋與輸入電容之間畫出換流環並追蹤回流。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the commutation loop between half bridge and input capacitor, including return. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「分析高 di/dt 迴路：反證與驗收」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for analyze high-di/dt loops: challenge and acceptance?
options: 效率相同代表最高接面溫度相同
在半橋與輸入電容之間畫出換流環並追蹤回流。
電感移到封裝裡就沒有磁芯損耗
optionsEn: Equal efficiency implies equal peak junction temperature
Draw the commutation loop between half bridge and input capacitor, including return.
Moving the inductor into the package removes core loss
quiz.explanation: 切換回路寄生電感會產生過衝，縮短直線導線不如縮小閉合回路直接。 在半橋與輸入電容之間畫出換流環並追蹤回流。
quiz.explanationEn: Switch-loop inductance produces overshoot; shrinking the closed loop is more relevant than trace length alone. Draw the commutation loop between half bridge and input capacitor, including return.

steps.title: 檢查磁場串擾
steps.objective: 建立「檢查磁場串擾」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：磁性元件漏磁可耦合感測與高速互連，需要空間及頻譜兩種隔離觀點。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for check magnetic coupling: Inductor leakage flux can couple into sensing and high-speed links; consider spatial and spectral isolation.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。改變受擾回路方向，預測感應雜訊應如何變化。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Rotate a victim loop and predict how induced noise should change. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：改變受擾回路方向，預測感應雜訊應如何變化。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Rotate a victim loop and predict how induced noise should change. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：電感移到封裝裡就沒有磁芯損耗。本步先檢查「檢查磁場串擾」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到磁性元件漏磁可耦合感測與高速互連，需要空間及頻譜兩種隔離觀點。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Moving the inductor into the package removes core loss. First check whether evidence for check magnetic coupling actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Inductor leakage flux can couple into sensing and high-speed links; consider spatial and spectral isolation.
steps.check: 交付「檢查磁場串擾」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for check magnetic coupling, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 檢查磁場串擾：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Check magnetic coupling: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「檢查磁場串擾」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the check magnetic coupling model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。改變受擾回路方向，預測感應雜訊應如何變化。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Rotate a victim loop and predict how induced noise should change. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：改變受擾回路方向，預測感應雜訊應如何變化。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Rotate a victim loop and predict how induced noise should change. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：效率相同代表最高接面溫度相同。本步先檢查「檢查磁場串擾」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到磁性元件漏磁可耦合感測與高速互連，需要空間及頻譜兩種隔離觀點。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Equal efficiency implies equal peak junction temperature. First check whether evidence for check magnetic coupling actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Inductor leakage flux can couple into sensing and high-speed links; consider spatial and spectral isolation.
steps.check: 交付「檢查磁場串擾」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for check magnetic coupling: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 散熱蓋與熱介面材料
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入熱擴散、接觸熱阻與 TIM 厚度；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine heat spreading, contact resistance and tim thickness. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。R=t/(kA) 適用均勻一維導熱；局部熱點、接觸粗糙與擴散電阻須另外處理，不能用材料 k 直接替代整組封裝表現。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. R=t/(kA) assumes uniform one-dimensional conduction; hotspots, rough contact and spreading resistance require additional treatment.

steps.title: 校正溫度量測
steps.objective: 建立「校正溫度量測」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：紅外表觀溫度受放射率影響，金屬反射可造成假熱點或假冷點。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for calibrate temperature measurement: Infrared apparent temperature depends on emissivity; metal reflections can create false hot or cold spots.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。以獨立溫度感測點驗證一個 IR 區域。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Validate one IR region with an independent temperature sensor. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：以獨立溫度感測點驗證一個 IR 區域。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Validate one IR region with an independent temperature sensor. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：熱導率最高的材料一定有最低組裝熱阻。本步先檢查「校正溫度量測」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到紅外表觀溫度受放射率影響，金屬反射可造成假熱點或假冷點。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: The highest-conductivity material always gives the lowest assembled resistance. First check whether evidence for calibrate temperature measurement actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Infrared apparent temperature depends on emissivity; metal reflections can create false hot or cold spots.
steps.check: 交付「校正溫度量測」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

steps.instruction:

courses.title: 微流道晶片冷卻
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入微流道對流、壓降、熱點與泵功；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine microchannel convection, pressure drop, hotspots and pump power. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。單相穩態水流算例不涵蓋沸騰、氣泡堵塞與冷卻液材料相容性；製作和加壓測試需專業設備。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Single-phase steady-water examples exclude boiling, bubble blockage and coolant compatibility; fabrication and pressurized testing require professional equipment.

knowledge.text: 將熱阻與液壓功置於同一圖，不只排名最低熱阻。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Plot thermal resistance against hydraulic power rather than ranking resistance alone. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「平衡傳熱與壓降」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for balance heat transfer and pressure drop?
options: 增加表面積可能提高傳熱，同時增加摩擦壓降和泵能耗。
通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低
冷卻液出口溫度就是晶片最高溫度
optionsEn: More surface area may improve heat transfer while raising frictional drop and pumping cost.
Narrower channels always reduce total system energy
Coolant outlet temperature equals peak chip temperature
quiz.explanation: 增加表面積可能提高傳熱，同時增加摩擦壓降和泵能耗。 將熱阻與液壓功置於同一圖，不只排名最低熱阻。
quiz.explanationEn: More surface area may improve heat transfer while raising frictional drop and pumping cost. Plot thermal resistance against hydraulic power rather than ranking resistance alone.

steps.title: 平衡傳熱與壓降：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Balance heat transfer and pressure drop: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「平衡傳熱與壓降」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the balance heat transfer and pressure drop model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。將熱阻與液壓功置於同一圖，不只排名最低熱阻。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Plot thermal resistance against hydraulic power rather than ranking resistance alone. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：將熱阻與液壓功置於同一圖，不只排名最低熱阻。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Plot thermal resistance against hydraulic power rather than ranking resistance alone. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：冷卻液出口溫度就是晶片最高溫度。本步先檢查「平衡傳熱與壓降」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到增加表面積可能提高傳熱，同時增加摩擦壓降和泵能耗。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Coolant outlet temperature equals peak chip temperature. First check whether evidence for balance heat transfer and pressure drop actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: More surface area may improve heat transfer while raising frictional drop and pumping cost.
steps.check: 交付「平衡傳熱與壓降」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for balance heat transfer and pressure drop: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.title: 檢查密封界面
steps.objective: 建立「檢查密封界面」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：接合層、通孔與接頭都是可能漏點，冷卻效果與密封完整性是獨立要求。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for check sealing interfaces: Bond layers, vias and fittings are possible leak paths; cooling and sealing are independent requirements.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫出濕區與電路區邊界，列每個穿越界面的密封證據。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw wet and electrical regions and list sealing evidence for each crossing. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫出濕區與電路區邊界，列每個穿越界面的密封證據。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw wet and electrical regions and list sealing evidence for each crossing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「檢查密封界面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到接合層、通孔與接頭都是可能漏點，冷卻效果與密封完整性是獨立要求。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for check sealing interfaces actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Bond layers, vias and fittings are possible leak paths; cooling and sealing are independent requirements.
steps.check: 交付「檢查密封界面」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for check sealing interfaces, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

stages.title: 耦合驗證
stages.description: 本階段處理耦合驗證：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address coupled validation through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 驗證溫度場
steps.objective: 建立「驗證溫度場」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：流體出口平均溫度不能代表晶片峰值，需把固體導熱和流體對流連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for validate temperature fields: Mean outlet temperature is not peak die temperature; couple solid conduction to fluid convection.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較兩種熱點形狀，保持總熱量及流量相同。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare two hotspot shapes at identical total heat and flow. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較兩種熱點形狀，保持總熱量及流量相同。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare two hotspot shapes at identical total heat and flow. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「驗證溫度場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到流體出口平均溫度不能代表晶片峰值，需把固體導熱和流體對流連接。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for validate temperature fields actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mean outlet temperature is not peak die temperature; couple solid conduction to fluid convection.
steps.check: 交付「驗證溫度場」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for validate temperature fields, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 評估網格與入口條件
steps.objective: 建立「評估網格與入口條件」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：入口發展區及邊界層需要解析，完全發展假設可能低估局部差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for assess mesh and inlet conditions: Entrance development and boundary layers require resolution; fully developed assumptions can miss local variation.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。改變入口長度與網格密度，追蹤壓降與峰溫收斂。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Vary entrance length and mesh density, tracking pressure-drop and peak-temperature convergence. courses.title: 氣密封裝與漏率檢測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入腔體漏率、滲透與細漏/粗漏；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine cavity leakage, permeation and fine/gross leak tests. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。氦等效漏率不能不經轉換就當成實際空氣或水汽漏率；測試門檻須依腔體容積、氣體及用途設定。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Helium-equivalent leak rates are not automatically air or moisture leak rates; limits depend on cavity volume, gas and application.

stages.descriptionEn: Address leak metrology through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 先辨粗漏
steps.objective: 建立「先辨粗漏」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：大漏可能讓示蹤氣體在量測前流失，導致細漏假陰性。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for screen gross leaks first: A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：氦細漏合格即可省略粗漏檢查。本步先檢查「先辨粗漏」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到大漏可能讓示蹤氣體在量測前流失，導致細漏假陰性。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for screen gross leaks first actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative.
steps.check: 交付「先辨粗漏」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for screen gross leaks first, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.titleEn: Screen gross leaks first: mechanism

knowledge.text: 列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「先辨粗漏」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for screen gross leaks first?
options: 氣密表示完全沒有內部放氣
大漏可能讓示蹤氣體在量測前流失，導致細漏假陰性。

optionsEn: Hermetic means no internal outgassing
A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative.

quiz.explanationEn: A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative. List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay.

steps.title: 先辨粗漏：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Screen gross leaks first: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「先辨粗漏」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the screen gross leaks first model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：氣密表示完全沒有內部放氣。本步先檢查「先辨粗漏」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到大漏可能讓示蹤氣體在量測前流失，導致細漏假陰性。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Hermetic means no internal outgassing. First check whether evidence for screen gross leaks first actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative.
steps.check: 交付「先辨粗漏」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for screen gross leaks first: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.title: 正確使用單位
steps.objective: 建立「正確使用單位」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：漏率常是壓力乘體積除時間，不是單純體積流率。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for use leak units correctly: Leak throughput often has pressure-volume/time units, not volume/time alone.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。檢查算例 Qt/V 的量綱。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設腔體 V=0.1 cm³、定常氣體通量 Q=10⁻⁹ atm·cm³/s，忽略吸附及壓差變化，1 天壓升為 Qt/V=8.64×10⁻⁴ atm；這只是初始線性上限模型。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Check dimensions of Qt/V in the example. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

For V=0.1 cm³ and constant throughput Q=10⁻⁹ atm·cm³/s, neglecting adsorption and pressure changes, one-day rise is Qt/V=8.64×10⁻⁴ atm. This is an initial linear model.

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for use leak units correctly actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Leak throughput often has pressure-volume/time units, not volume/time alone.

knowledge.titleEn: Hypothetical worked example and model boundary
knowledge.text: 假設腔體 V=0.1 cm³、定常氣體通量 Q=10⁻⁹ atm·cm³/s，忽略吸附及壓差變化，1 天壓升為 Qt/V=8.64×10⁻⁴ atm；這只是初始線性上限模型。 氦等效漏率不能不經轉換就當成實際空氣或水汽漏率；測試門檻須依腔體容積、氣體及用途設定。

Helium-equivalent leak rates are not automatically air or moisture leak rates; limits depend on cavity volume, gas and application.

courses.title: 晶圓級真空封裝
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入微腔真空、氣體負載與吸氣劑；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine microcavity vacuum, gas load and getters. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。P=Q/S 為穩態集中模型；微腔氣體成分、吸附、吸氣容量和封口時間歷史會改變結果。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. P=Q/S is a steady lumped model; gas species, adsorption, getter capacity and sealing history change microcavity behavior.

courses.title: 功率模組銀燒結接合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入銀燒結頸部、孔隙與界面可靠度；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine silver sinter necks, porosity and interface reliability. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。材料廠建議是特定配方的範圍；本課不給通用壓力溫度配方，孔隙率也不能單獨預測疲勞壽命。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Vendor windows apply to specific formulations; no universal pressure-temperature recipe is supplied, and porosity alone does not predict fatigue life.

courses.title: 功率模組雙面散熱
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入雙面散熱熱阻分配、電氣隔離與機械約束；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine double-sided heat sharing, isolation and mechanical constraint. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。兩支路並聯公式假設相同參考溫度及集中熱源；不對稱流體溫度和空間熱點需用完整網路。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Parallel resistance assumes equal reference temperatures and a lumped source; unequal coolants and hotspots need a full network.

knowledge.text: 標出每一支路的接合與絕緣層。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Mark bonds and insulating layers in each branch. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「畫出熱阻分支」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for draw thermal branches?
options: 共享晶片熱源與不同串聯界面構成並聯網路。
雙面散熱永遠剛好降低一半接面溫度
散熱更好就不必驗證絕緣
optionsEn: A shared die source and distinct series interfaces form parallel branches.
Double-sided cooling always halves junction temperature
Better cooling eliminates isolation verification
quiz.explanation: 共享晶片熱源與不同串聯界面構成並聯網路。 標出每一支路的接合與絕緣層。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared die source and distinct series interfaces form parallel branches. Mark bonds and insulating layers in each branch.

steps.title: 畫出熱阻分支：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Draw thermal branches: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「畫出熱阻分支」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the draw thermal branches model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。標出每一支路的接合與絕緣層。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Mark bonds and insulating layers in each branch. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：標出每一支路的接合與絕緣層。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Mark bonds and insulating layers in each branch. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：散熱更好就不必驗證絕緣。本步先檢查「畫出熱阻分支」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到共享晶片熱源與不同串聯界面構成並聯網路。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Better cooling eliminates isolation verification. First check whether evidence for draw thermal branches actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A shared die source and distinct series interfaces form parallel branches.
steps.check: 交付「畫出熱阻分支」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for draw thermal branches: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 陶瓷直接覆銅基板
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入DBC 陶瓷絕緣、銅層擴散及邊缘應力；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine dbc insulation, copper heat spreading and edge stress. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。資料表典型 k 和耐壓只適用所列測試條件；DBC、AMB 與薄膜金屬化不可視為同一製程。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Datasheet conductivity and breakdown values apply to stated conditions; DBC, AMB and thin-film metallization are distinct processes.

steps.title: 比較陶瓷材料
steps.objective: 建立「比較陶瓷材料」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：Al₂O₃、AlN 與 Si₃N₄ 在導熱及韌性間有不同權衡。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for compare ceramics: Al₂O₃, AlN and Si₃N₄ trade conductivity against toughness differently.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。只用同條件資料比較性能。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare properties only under matched conditions. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：只用同條件資料比較性能。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare properties only under matched conditions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「比較陶瓷材料」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到Al₂O₃、AlN 與 Si₃N₄ 在導熱及韌性間有不同權衡。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism. First check whether evidence for compare ceramics actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Al₂O₃, AlN and Si₃N₄ trade conductivity against toughness differently.
steps.check: 交付「比較陶瓷材料」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for compare ceramics, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

courses.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入溫度循環歷史、CTE 失配及失效統計；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine thermal-cycle history, cte mismatch and failure statistics. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。加速試驗僅在機制相同時支持外推；零失效不等於無限壽命，環境熱循環與功率循環也不可直接互換。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Accelerated tests support extrapolation only with unchanged mechanisms; zero failures do not imply infinite life, and ambient and power cycling are distinct.

courses.title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入水分擴散、界面剝離與回焊蒸汽壓；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine moisture diffusion, delamination and reflow vapor pressure. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。本課不是 MSL 標準替代品；實際等級、烘烤與回焊條件須依封裝規格及現行標準。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. This course does not replace MSL standards; actual classification, bake and reflow conditions require package specifications and current standards.

courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入焊點蠕變、疲勞能量及模型外推；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine solder creep, fatigue energy and model extrapolation. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。Coffin–Manson 與能量法係數需要材料和試驗校準；本課算例只展示比例敏感度，不產生可保證的服役壽命。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Coffin–Manson and energy-model coefficients require material/test calibration; examples show sensitivity, not guaranteed service life.

steps.objective: 建立「套用應變壽命比例」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：冪律指數控制對應變幅度的敏感度，需要實驗支持。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for apply strain-life scaling: The power-law exponent controls strain sensitivity and needs experimental support.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。重算 4000 至 1000 的比例例。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設 N=C(Δεp)^(-2)，某樣品 Δεp=0.01 時 N=4000；若 Δεp=0.02，比例模型預測 N=1000。指數若為 1.5，則為 1414；模型形式的不確定度顯著。

Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Recalculate the 4000-to-1000 scaling example. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

Assume N=C(Δεp)^(-2) and N=4000 at Δεp=0.01. At 0.02 the model gives N=1000; exponent 1.5 instead gives 1414, illustrating model-form uncertainty.

steps.title: 納入散布與設限：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Include scatter and censoring: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「納入散布與設限」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the include scatter and censoring model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。建立含設限欄位的校準表。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Create calibration data with censoring fields. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：建立含設限欄位的校準表。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Create calibration data with censoring fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：線彈性最大應力可完整預測焊料循環壽命。本步先檢查「納入散布與設限」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到未失效樣品提供生存資訊，不能刪除或當終點失效。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Peak linear-elastic stress completely predicts solder life. First check whether evidence for include scatter and censoring actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Survivors contain information and cannot be discarded or counted as endpoint failures.
steps.check: 交付「納入散布與設限」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for include scatter and censoring: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List operating points outside validated tests. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All solders share the same fatigue constants. First check whether evidence for assess extrapolation actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Extrapolation across material, geometry or temperature can change the mechanism.
steps.check: 交付「評估模型外推」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for assess extrapolation, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

courses.title: 封裝聲學顯微檢測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入聲阻抗、飛行時間與 C-SAM 界面圖；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine acoustic impedance, time of flight and c-sam interface maps. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。影像亮度取決於閘門、頻率與相位；暗區或亮區不具有普遍固定的缺陷含義，水耦合亦需評估樣品相容性。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Brightness depends on gate, frequency and phase; bright/dark regions have no universal defect meaning, and water coupling requires sample compatibility.

stages.title: 聲波與界面
stages.description: 本階段處理聲波與界面：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address sound and interfaces through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 辨識聲阻抗界面
steps.objective: 建立「辨識聲阻抗界面」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：反射由密度乘聲速的差異決定，不只由材料硬度。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for identify impedance interfaces: Reflection depends on density-times-sound-speed mismatch, not just hardness.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。標示封裝各層聲阻抗差異。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Mark impedance changes through package layers. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

courses.title: 封裝 X 光電腦斷層檢測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入X-ray CT 投影、體素與重建偽影；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine x-ray ct projections, voxels and reconstruction artifacts. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。體素尺寸不等於解析度；CT 未見缺陷不表示界面無裂縫，尤其薄而低對比缺陷須用其他方法交叉驗證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Voxel size is not resolution; absent CT contrast does not prove a crack-free interface, especially for thin low-contrast defects.

stages.description: 本階段處理投影與吸收：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address projection and absorption through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define inspection target: Voids, bridges and cracks differ in scale and orientation; define the target first.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。為每類缺陷列最小關注尺度。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

courses.title: 矽光子 SOI 波導製作
courses.titleEn: SOI waveguide fabrication for silicon photonics
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SOI 波導侷限、側壁散射與 cutback；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine soi confinement, sidewall scattering and cutback. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。波導尺寸須依實際 PDK；本課不把單一公開截面當成所有代工廠共通設計規則。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Waveguide dimensions must follow the actual PDK; one public cross-section is not a universal foundry rule.

steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「畫出 SOI 截面」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。

steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。標記 strip 與 rib 的不同邊界。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Mark differing strip and rib boundaries. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Mark differing strip and rib boundaries. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：單條波導插入損耗就是傳播損耗。本步先檢查「畫出 SOI 截面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到矽核心、埋氧與上包覆共同決定模態，不只核心寬度。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: One waveguide insertion loss equals propagation loss. First check whether evidence for draw soi cross-section actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Silicon core, buried oxide and top cladding jointly determine modes.
steps.check: 交付「畫出 SOI 截面」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for draw soi cross-section: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 氮化矽低損耗波導
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SiN 低損耗、薄膜應力與吸收頻譜；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine sin low loss, film stress and absorption spectra. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。不同沉積與退火路徑不可互換；低損耗紀錄屬特定波長與製程，不是所有 SiN 元件的保證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Deposition and annealing routes are not interchangeable; record losses apply to specified wavelength/process, not every SiN device.

options: SiN 沒有任何材料吸收
溫度漂移會使狹窄共振掃描失真或看似變寬。
負載 Q 可不經校正直接當內部 Q
optionsEn: SiN has no material absorption
Thermal drift can distort or broaden narrow resonance scans.
Loaded Q directly equals intrinsic Q

steps.title: 追蹤熱頻移：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Track thermal resonance shift: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「追蹤熱頻移」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the track thermal resonance shift model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較上下掃頻與不同光功率。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare up/down sweeps and optical powers. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較上下掃頻與不同光功率。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare up/down sweeps and optical powers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：SiN 沒有任何材料吸收。本步先檢查「追蹤熱頻移」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到溫度漂移會使狹窄共振掃描失真或看似變寬。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: SiN has no material absorption. First check whether evidence for track thermal resonance shift actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Thermal drift can distort or broaden narrow resonance scans.
steps.check: 交付「追蹤熱頻移」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for track thermal resonance shift: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 次波長光柵波導
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SWG Bloch 模態、填充比與頻散；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine swg bloch modes, fill factor and dispersion. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。有效介質只在適當次波長及緩變條件近似成立；接近 Bragg 區或尖銳不連續處需全波/Bloch 分析。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Effective medium is approximate in a suitable subwavelength, slowly varying regime; near Bragg conditions or discontinuities use full-wave/Bloch analysis.

stages.title: 週期與有效介質
stages.description: 本階段處理週期與有效介質：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address period and effective medium through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義週期方向
steps.objective: 建立「定義週期方向」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：週期必須相對傳播方向與偏振定義。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define periodic direction: Period must be defined relative to propagation and polarization.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫單胞、週期與光傳播向量。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫單胞、週期與光傳播向量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw unit cell, period and propagation vector. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：只要週期小於自由空間波長就沒有 Bragg 效應。本步先檢查「定義週期方向」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到週期必須相對傳播方向與偏振定義。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Any period below free-space wavelength avoids Bragg effects. First check whether evidence for define periodic direction actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Period must be defined relative to propagation and polarization.
steps.check: 交付「定義週期方向」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

steps.title: 驗證頻帶邊界：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Validate band boundaries: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「驗證頻帶邊界」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the validate band boundaries model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。掃最短至最長工作波長。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Sweep the full operating wavelength range. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：掃最短至最長工作波長。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Sweep the full operating wavelength range. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：填充比平均折射率永遠精確。本步先檢查「驗證頻帶邊界」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中心波長低損耗不代表整個頻帶都遠離帶邊。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Fill-factor-averaged index is always exact. First check whether evidence for validate band boundaries actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Low loss at center wavelength does not guarantee distance from band edges everywhere.
steps.check: 交付「驗證頻帶邊界」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for validate band boundaries: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for separate scattering and absorption: Reduced transmission can be reflection, radiation or absorption.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。記錄 T、R 及剩餘能量項。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Record T, R and remaining energy terms. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Record T, R and remaining energy terms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：只要週期小於自由空間波長就沒有 Bragg 效應。本步先檢查「分離散射與吸收」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到傳輸下降可能是反射、輻射或吸收，總功率需分流核對。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Any period below free-space wavelength avoids Bragg effects. First check whether evidence for separate scattering and absorption actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Reduced transmission can be reflection, radiation or absorption.
steps.check: 交付「分離散射與吸收」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for separate scattering and absorption, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

courses.title: 光柵耦合器設計
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入光柵相位匹配、方向性與模場重疊；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine grating phase matching, directionality and modal overlap. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。簡化光柵方程只給初始週期；最佳效率需考慮向下輻射、反射、有限孔徑、偏振與實際纖芯模場。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. The simple grating equation only seeds period; efficiency also depends on downward radiation, reflection, aperture, polarization and fiber fields.

stages.title: 相位與光纖
stages.description: 本階段處理相位與光纖：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address phase and fiber through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 設定光纖與偏振
steps.objective: 建立「設定光纖與偏振」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for specify fiber and polarization: The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。記錄模場直徑及偏振定義。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Record mode-field diameter and polarization. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：記錄模場直徑及偏振定義。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Record mode-field diameter and polarization. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

courses.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入邊緣耦合模場展開、端面反射與對準；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine edge-coupler mode expansion, facet reflection and alignment. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。高斯重疊只是近似；實際向量模態、端面角度、空隙與偏振需用完整場解或量測驗證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Gaussian overlap is approximate; vector modes, facet angle, gaps and polarization need field simulation or measurement.

stages.title: 模態與展模
stages.description: 本階段處理模態與展模：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address modes and expansion through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 比較晶片與光纖模場
steps.objective: 建立「比較晶片與光纖模場」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for compare chip and fiber modes: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「比較晶片與光纖模場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for compare chip and fiber modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.
steps.check: 交付「比較晶片與光纖模場」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for compare chip and fiber modes, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 比較晶片與光纖模場：反證與驗收

steps.objectiveEn: Test the compare chip and fiber modes model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Mode-field diameter and radius are interchangeable. First check whether evidence for compare chip and fiber modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.
steps.check: 交付「比較晶片與光纖模場」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for compare chip and fiber modes: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.title: 建立橫向容差
steps.objective: 建立「建立橫向容差」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：較大模場可增加偏移容忍，但也改變封裝尺寸需求。

steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。重算 1 μm 偏移的 1.09 dB 例。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

相同高斯模場假設 η=exp[−(Δx/w)²]，w=2 μm、偏移 1 μm 時 η=0.779、損耗 1.09 dB；w 為 1/e² 強度半徑。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Recalculate 1.09 dB loss at 1 μm offset. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. steps.objective: 建立「評估端面損傷」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：切割微裂與碎屑可造成散射，對準重試不能修復。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for assess facet damage: Dicing cracks and debris scatter light; realignment cannot repair them.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較端面影像與對準掃描形狀。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較端面影像與對準掃描形狀。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「評估端面損傷」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到切割微裂與碎屑可造成散射，對準重試不能修復。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for assess facet damage actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Dicing cracks and debris scatter light; realignment cannot repair them.
steps.check: 交付「評估端面損傷」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for assess facet damage, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

quiz.explanationEn: Dicing cracks and debris scatter light; realignment cannot repair them. Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes.

steps.title: 評估端面損傷：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Assess facet damage: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「評估端面損傷」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the assess facet damage model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較端面影像與對準掃描形狀。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較端面影像與對準掃描形狀。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：模場直徑可與半徑混用。本步先檢查「評估端面損傷」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到切割微裂與碎屑可造成散射，對準重試不能修復。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Mode-field diameter and radius are interchangeable. First check whether evidence for assess facet damage actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Dicing cracks and debris scatter light; realignment cannot repair them.
steps.check: 交付「評估端面損傷」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for assess facet damage: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

place.name: imec 魯汶園區（公開研究代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 官方會議場址公布的園區代表座標；本課採用多國公開來源，不主張每一技術在此發明或量產，也不是設備位置。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Campus reference coordinates published for an official event. The course draws on international sources; this is not a claim of local invention, production or equipment location.

places.summary: 本課以回流路徑、頻率相依 RLGC 與模型因果性連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
places.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through return paths, frequency-dependent rlgc and model causality. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.title: 合作研究中心在魯汶成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center starts in Leuven
history.text: imec 官方歷史記錄其成立背景；共同研究模式使材料、元件和系統問題能在同一研究環境連結。
history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

places.connection: 將地圖視為研究交流的定位點，再依每個來源了解不同機構在材料、設備、量測與系統驗證上的分工。
places.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.

history.text: imec 官方歷史記錄其成立背景；共同研究模式使材料、元件和系統問題能在同一研究環境連結。
history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

places.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.

places.summary: 本課以SiN 低損耗、薄膜應力與吸收頻譜連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
places.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through sin low loss, film stress and absorption spectra. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

related.title: 封裝供電完整性設計
related.why: 回流與阻抗預算可轉為供電網路模型
related.whyEn: Return and impedance budgets transfer to PDN models
related.transfer: 回流與阻抗預算可轉為供電網路模型
related.transferEn: Return and impedance budgets transfer to PDN models
related.difference: 寄生萃取提供元件；供電完整性要加上負載頻譜與穩壓器
related.differenceEn: Extraction supplies components; PI adds load spectra and regulators
practice: 畫出「封裝寄生參數萃取」與「封裝供電完整性設計」的材料、能量或資料交接。
以「畫出閉合電流回路」為比較起點，指出兩課共享的守恆或量測原理。
提出一個會使「回流與阻抗預算可轉為供電網路模型」失效的邊界條件，並安排驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the material, energy or data handoff between Package parasitic extraction and Package power-integrity design.
Use draw closed current loops to identify a shared conservation or measurement principle.
State and test one boundary that would invalidate this transfer: Return and impedance budgets transfer to PDN models
